rules.topic: Powercell tiers (config defaults): tier 1 holds 500000 RF, tier 2 holds 4000000 RF (line 27), tier 3 holds 20000000 RF (line 30); per-cell transfer rates are 250 / 1000 / 4000 RF/t (lines 34/37/40), and adjacent cells form one network whose capacity is the sum, up to a 9x9x9 network (networkMax, line 48)
The coal generator makes 60 RF/t and burns one coal per 600 ticks (line 24) for 36000 RF per coal, with a 500000 RF buffer and 2000 RF/t output

Dimensional cells share one cross-dimension power network per cell id: each normal cell adds 1000000 RF capacity (advanced cells x4, line 33), transfer runs at 5000 RF/t per cell (line 26) with charging up to 30000 RF/t (line 53), and long-distance transfer pays a distance-based cost factor - this is the pack's built-in cross-dimension power option alongside RFTools Dimensions (see the rftoolsdim rule file)
